statement: At the pinned SDL commit, the Switch 2 HIDAPI USB driver dispatches left and right Joy-Con 2 independently, mapping each as a sideways mini gamepad by default or in vertical/parent mode. The right-side C button is recognized and both sides expose auxiliary paddle/grip controls. SDL's default gamepad mapping also has a separate pair mapping; this is a consumer construct, not evidence of native combined-device identity.

applicability.scope: SDL gamepad remapping of left, right and pair
